tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Day 24 07:28 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of nightstand_b1. It does not stay on the nightstand in the morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning; coffee_table_l1 for mid-day; bed_b1 for late night.

mug_felix: Inconsistent. Day 24 07:29 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of cupboard_k1. It is not in the cupboard in the morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 for morning and evening; coffee_table_l1 for mid-day.

glass_felix: Unpredictable. Day 25 21:41 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of cupboard_k1. Day 25 22:45 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of cupboard_k1. Day 26 22:01 feedback showed nightstand_b1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. It does not stay in the cupboard or living room at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late night; kitchen_table_k1 for early evening.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Day 24 22:59 feedback showed entry_hook_e1, contradicting my guess of desk_b1. Day 26 22:01 feedback showed nightstand_b1, contradicting my guess of entry_hook_e1. It does not stay in the entryway at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late night; entry_hook_e1 for mid-day.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between living and kitchen table. Day 22 19:12 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for late evening; coffee_table_l1 for early morning.

book_felix: Inconsistent. Day 21 22:38 feedback showed bed_b1, but Day 22 11:14 and Day 23 18:06 feedback showed coffee_table_l1. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day, afternoon, and evening; bed_b1 only for late-night locations.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Day 25 07:11 feedback showed bathroom_shelf_ba1, contradicting my guess of medicine_cabinet_ba1. Day 26 07:00 feedback showed bathroom_shelf_ba1, contradicting my guess of sink_ba_ba1. It is not in the cabinet or sink in the morning. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning.
